name: css_no_default_exit
description: NO ANIMATION UNLESS CONFIGURED (USER ruling 2026-08-17): a node without -azul-animation-out is NOT retained - no zombie, no automatic slide, the dom just disappears the frame it unmounts; a node without -azul-animation-in just APPEARS. Sidebar-style fly-outs are something user or library code declares (@keyframes or a component-attached callback), never an engine default. Structural MOVES still animate (the card's spring) - presence is what became opt-in. This scenario replaced css_catch_slide: with no default slides there are no manager presence-exits left to catch; the track-flavour catch (css_catch_mid_exit) carries that coverage.
